Initial release of nerf-to-3dgs-migrator.  
Guides users in migrating NeRF-based methods to 3D Gaussian Splatting.

- Provides a detailed breakdown of paradigm differences between NeRF and 3DGS.
- Outlines a step-by-step migration workflow, analyzing core components and mapping them between NeRF and 3DGS.
- Supplies migration strategies and code templates for common modules: encoding, density, rendering, deformation, and appearance.
- Identifies incompatibilities and offers workarounds for features not natively supported in 3DGS.
- Includes guidance on training adaptation and explicit tips on component initialization and parameter tuning.
- Supports both English and Chinese triggers for ease of use.
